name: hbm_sfu_programme_store_r7c_1016-r7c-COMMIT
purpose: NEW master: SFU programme store (both fixed SFU calendars, 11 stripes x 2 pages = 22 ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256) split out of ot_hgi_sfu_scheduled_engine (main 697997629, split equivalence receipt results/rtl/hbm_sfu_split_1016) for die slot sfus_<q>. Each stripe = one row of two back-to-back SRAMs (W MY, E R0) whose rd_out faces a shared 40 um logic channel; the 222-bit stripe word runs west along its own 20 um row channel to the W-face output registers toward sfucore_<q>; host cfg/start on N. | r1 gate (41fbe28f5) TritonCTS: 16 buffers per path, TT insertion 565.8..745.2 ps / spread 179.4 over 447x1024 um -> pre-placed balanced clock spine from the W-centre entry; N host pins spread (cfg_data / io_cfg_data ranged across the face, were clustered in 40 um); W output ranges aligned to the stripe rows (io_word rows 0-2, compiler_control rows 3-10). | r4 (Claude H-SU 10-16): actual 092026 IOP PPL-0086 io_cfg_addr group 11 in N427.3..446.7: measured N slots are ~2.3-5 per um (PPL-0078 sections, e.g. 4.75 um = 11 slots), not 10.5, so 88/89 control bits do not fit 19.4 um bands. Control bands widened to N0.3..48.0 and N399.0..446.7 (47.7 um each, ~2x the measured need); cfg_data N50..215 and io_cfg_data N232..397 (165 um / 256 bits = 1.55/um, the r1-r3 data windows ran 1.31/um). Same face, ports, bit order, group size 16, outline, W face, clock/reset tracks. | r4b: r4 gate 094919 IOP PPL-0086 'group of size 1': PPL places the 16-bit compiler_control groups (range W296..1004) before the scalar clk (W506..514) / rst_n (W515..519) groups, and they took those slots. compiler_control now W520.5..1004 (1742 bits / 483.5 um = 3.6/um on M4), disjoint from clk/rst; clock entry stays at the W centre. Rows 3-5 (y296..505) compiler_control bits run up to 220 um north inside the tile; W296..505 left free. | r5 (Claude H-SU): r4b 095449 IOP PPL-0086 again on TOP: measured TOP sections hold only ~0.5-1 slot/um (PPL-0078: 4 slots in 399.1..403.3, 8 in 200.6..215.0) under the M3/M5 straps, so 689 N pins cannot fit 447 um. The W face carries 2,213 M4 pins at 3.6/um. r5: all host cfg/start/status pins move N->E (M4): arithmetic ctl E962..1020, cfg_data E704..958, io_cfg_data E446..700, io ctl E384..442 (<=1.5 pins/um). W face/clk/rst unchanged.

structural_change: r7c (H-SU 10-16; r6 route hbm_sfu_programme_store_r6_1016-r6-4faed2823 NEEDS_RTL TT -89.42 / FF -69.15): root cause measured on the r6/r7b netlists -- all stripes' cfg_data_q (wd) merged by synthesis into ONE register driving the 16 programme SRAM wd_in (+1 for the 6 IO SRAMs) across the 1 mm tile (11 placement buffers, 1586 ps arrival). Fix: one (* keep *) registered write-data/address copy per stripe pair beside its macro rows + per-stripe write strobe; launch legality/span/loop flag computed in front of the existing launch registers (TT -41.6 class); rem/loops_one replace the pc+1==limit / loops==1 compares; r7 fully synchronous regional reset tree (2-flop sync -> 3 region relays -> 12 stripe/pin relays, no async clear). SRAM address in (pc reg), data in (kept copy) and Q out (captured) registered. Cycle delta vs r6: none on the datapath (D=4, status 2); reset release 3 -> 4 edges. r7b (per-page Q regs, D=10) rejected by its gate: 22,078 sinks > 15,000 on one root. Balanced pins over disjoint per-port ranges (<= 6/um guidance; max 3.6/um). Same outline/faces/floorplan as r5/r6.
